info.name: Onboarding Readiness — Live Prototype
info.description: Stateless FastAPI service that pulls live data from Jira / GitHub / Datadog and returns a per-project readiness tier. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your running host (default http://localhost:8000). See README.md for full field-level schema.

variable.description: Where the FastAPI service is running.

request.description: Returns a JSON array — one full report per project registered in projects.json. Each element has the same shape as GET /api/report/{key}.
